# Web Client and Container Checklist: Lönekrav web client and container

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements in spec.md, plan.md and contracts/. They cover data
integrity in the page, the chart's encoding and floor line, the two search speeds, honest-fit
framing, accessibility and phone width, the advisor drawer's states and privacy, and the
container's portability.
**Created**: 2026-10-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Data integrity in the page

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the spec say which page values may be derived (for example a scale tick or a
  margin's sign) and which must come straight from a payload, so that "no figure is computed in
  the page" can be judged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the wording of the note shown for a suppressed SCB value specified, or at least
  its required content (which value, and that SCB does not publish it)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007,
  Story 2 AC4]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the visual properties that make the simulated bar "visually distinct" stated
  precisely enough to review (outline, fill, label), and are they consistent between the spec and
  contracts/ui.md? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, contracts/ui.md]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified what the chart shows when a code has distributions for several
  years: only the latest, and is that year named? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the data-source credit's required wording traced to `data-dict.yaml`, rather than
  left as "as the data dictionary requires"? [Traceability, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK006 - Do the requirements state that legal text and amounts in the guide come only from
  the registry route, with no fallback copy written into the page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013,
  Plan R9]

## Chart encoding and floor line

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the source of the floor line defined unambiguously, both with and without an
  offer, and for an exempt, a banned and a partially banned code? [Completeness, data-model
  "Floor line", Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the scale rule (zero baseline, upper bound, tick step) specified, and the same for
  every row, so that bars for different codes can be compared? [Clarity, Plan R8]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the requirements for a row with no salary data at all consistent between the edge
  cases (the threshold line is still drawn) and FR-006? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is it defined which age bands appear as dots (all six, without "all") and how a
  missing band is shown? [Clarity, contracts/ui.md]
- [ ] CHK011 - Does the spec define the floor-line label format (rule name in words or id, amount
  formatting)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the reading order of the accessible table (rows by code, columns by percentile) and
  its parity with the chart specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Two-speed search

- [ ] CHK013 - Is "when the user pauses" quantified (the delay before the accurate search), and is
  the figure consistent between Story 1 and research R5? [Clarity, Spec Story 1 AC2, Plan R5]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the rule for when ad parsing is used (title against pasted ad) stated in the
  requirements or only in the plan, and is it visible to the user? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Plan R5]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are SC-001 (0.5 s) and SC-002 (3 s) defined on a stated machine, with a stated
  method of measurement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the behaviour defined when the fast search fails (a network error or a 422)
  rather than when it is slow? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is "a few seconds" in Story 1 AC2 replaced by, or traced to, SC-002? [Ambiguity,
  Spec Story 1 AC2]

## Honest-fit framing

- [ ] CHK018 - Is "no wording, ordering or highlighting suggests choosing the code that passes"
  turned into reviewable rules (for example columns kept in selection order, the same styling for
  pass and fail apart from the status)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is it specified where the honest-fit notice appears in each view, and that its text
  comes from the payload rather than from page copy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the advisor memo's footer requirements (shown unchanged) consistent with 003's
  contract? [Consistency, Spec Story 5 AC3, 003 contracts/a2a.md]

## Accessibility and phone width

- [ ] CHK021 - Is the accessibility standard named (for example WCAG 2.2 AA), beyond "no serious or
  critical violations" from an automated check? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are keyboard requirements stated for every interactive element (result selection,
  chips, toggles, drawer, cancel), not only for chart marks? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is "readable size" for chart text at phone width quantified? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge
  Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are colour-only encodings ruled out (pass/fail, simulated against official, legal
  flags)? [Gap]

## Advisor drawer states and privacy

- [ ] CHK025 - Is every run state (submitted, working, completed, failed, rejected, canceled, lost)
  given a defined message and a defined next action? [Completeness, data-model AdvisorRun]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the behaviour defined when the user sends a second request while a run is in
  progress? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the third-party notice's wording traced to one source (the card or the core
  constant), so the drawer and the memo cannot disagree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK028 - Does FR-024 cover every way the page could keep user text beyond the visit (browser
  storage, the address, logs, error reports)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the precedence defined when the advisor selects codes the user has just changed by
  hand? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]

## Container portability

- [ ] CHK030 - Is "no network download at start-up" stated as a testable requirement, with the means
  of checking it named? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026, Story 6 AC5]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the memory requirement specified with its measurement workload (which requests,
  and whether the accurate model is loaded) so that the 4 GB figure is reproducible? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-027, Plan R11]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the image's target architecture stated, and is the amd64 (managed service) caveat
  recorded in the requirements or only in research? [Assumption, Plan R10, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are the requirements for the public address complete: its format, the trailing slash
  and what happens with an invalid value? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is SC-006's "10 minutes of build time" consistent with downloading two models and
  installing torch during the build, or is the assumption stated? [Assumption, Spec §SC-006]

## Notes

- Items are numbered across the whole file. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not
  change the markers.
